category_title: At-risk dyscalculic pupils with core deficits in representing and processing numerosity
scenario_title: Inability to express quantity without concrete materials
minimal_context: The tutor asks David to express the quantity of seven using his fingers during a one-on-one assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: David, can you show me seven using your fingers?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at his hands but does not raise any fingers, not knowing how to count using them.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try. Show me seven.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Holds up his hands but fails to show the correct amount.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you count them out for me?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts his hands down, failing to do that because he does not know how to express the quantity.)

STUDENT: (Looks at his hands but does not raise any fingers, not knowing how to count using them.)
